The '''Imperial Embassy''' on [[Voss]] was owned by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire and was the headquarters of [[Darth Serevin]].
